classification.difficultyReason: Five figures share the same letters P and Q, so the student must separate line, two opposite rays, interval and point by arrowheads and by which letter starts the ray. This is still recognition and naming, with no calculation.

answer.worked: Arrowheads at both ends show a line extending forever in both directions. It is line PQ or QP.
The ray starts at Q and extends through P. Name the endpoint first: ray QP.
The ray starts at P and extends through Q. Name the endpoint first: ray PQ.
Two endpoints joined without arrowheads form an interval or line segment. It is interval PQ or QP.
A single labelled dot represents point Q.
